title: Crash, sticky keys, shift then esc, filter by events, editor shortcuts
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
- v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]
- v4.7.dev1.official [bf95b6258]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory

### Issue description

Godot crashes when win 11 sticky keys is enabled, and the following keys are pressed in:
editor settings > shortcuts > filter by events 
- press and release: `shift`
- press and release: `esc`

Godot freezes for about three seconds, then it closes.

Starting Godot in the Windows Terminal shows:
```
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed with signal 11

```

Sticky keys don't have to be enabled, it just makes the crash easy to reproduce, because Godot can also crash when sticky keys is disabled, by pressing and releasing both, `shift` and `esc` at the same time, but it usually takes a couple of tries.

When sticky keys is enabled, then Godot crashes every time `shift` is pressed followed by `esc`.

Godot does not crash when holding `shift` and pressing `esc`, when sticky keys is either enabled or disabled.


This might not be related, but:
Pressing `shift + esc` in Notepad++ shows an `ESC`  character, when enabling:
View > Show Symbols > Show Control Characters & Unicode EOL

### Steps to reproduce

- open: win 11, settings, accessibility, keyboard
- enable: sticky keys
- start Godot
- create a new project
- in the top menu choose: editor > editor settings...
- at the top of the editor settings window, click on the tab: shortcuts
- at the top right click in the input box: Filter by Event
- press and release: `shift` (shift remains pressed because of sticky keys)
- press `esc`
- Godot freezes for about three seconds, and sometimes the mouse pointer shows an hourglass
- Godot closes

It's also possible to crash Godot when sticky keys is disabled, by pressing and releasing both, `shift` and `esc` at the same time, but it usually takes a couple of tries.

When sticky keys is enabled, then Godot crashes every time `shift` is pressed followed by `esc`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A. It happens with a new empty project.
